_comment: No ConnectionStrings/Jwt section here on purpose - this base file is committed and must never contain a real secret. A non-Development environment MUST supply ConnectionStrings:CcmcDb and Jwt:Secret via environment variables (e.g. ConnectionStrings__CcmcDb, Jwt__Secret) or another secret store. See appsettings.Development.json for the local-dev-only placeholder values, and README.md 'Configuration' / 'Production Security Notes'.
